schema.description: UpdateWorkspaceNetworkPolicyRequest replaces the workspace's network policy.

baseUpdatedAt.description:
The updated_at of the policy this update was made from, as
GetWorkspaceNetworkPolicy returned it, or the zero timestamp
(1970-01-01T00:00:00Z) when it returned none (never saved). When set, the
update is refused with ABORTED if the policy was saved since, so a
concurrent change is not silently overwritten: load it again and reapply
the change. Unset skips the check, and the last save wins.

enabled.description: Whether sessions boot on a filtered network with the policy.

policy.description: The policy; an unset policy is stored as an empty one (deny everything).

defaultAction.description: Verdict for flows no rule matches; deny when unspecified.

rules.description: The rules, in order of precedence.

items.description: NetworkPolicyRule is one rule of a network policy.

action.description: Verdict of the rule; must be allow or deny.

match.description: What the rule matches; an empty match matches every flow.

l3.description: Layer 3: the destination address and name.

cidr.description: An IPv4 network in CIDR notation, for example 10.0.0.0/8.

host.description:
Destination name: an exact host name, or a `*.example.com` pattern
matching every name under example.com. Checked against the names the
session resolved through the host's DNS and, on TLS, against the SNI.

items.description: PortRange is an inclusive range of destination ports.

from.description: First port of the range, 1 to 65535.

to.description: Last port of the range, 1 to 65535; the single port `from` when unset.

tls.description: The TLS ClientHello. Only TCP flows can match.

alpnProtocols.description:
Accepted application protocols (h2, http/1.1, ...), as offered by the
client in ALPN; any when empty.

items.description: PortRange is an inclusive range of destination ports.

from.description: First port of the range, 1 to 65535.

to.description: Last port of the range, 1 to 65535; the single port `from` when unset.

name.description: Name of the rule, for the host's logs; the rule's position when empty.
